method: Original complete-character user-video frames, only technical green-screen matting and constant whole-frame registration. No interpolation, morphing, nasal overlays or local motion synthesis.
transitionPolicy: Queue looking, yawning and grooming until the current seated cycle has presented its last original frame for its source duration. Each one-shot returns to the selected seated tail mode. Tail setting changes retain a queued action and its cycle boundary. No crossfade or synthetic motion.
tailControl: Default random holds each intact seated variant for 1–3 complete cycles, then switches at its end. Manual moving/still choices are available. Look has priority and returns to the selected idle mode.
yawnMatting: Same original seated-video matting: fractional alpha, dense interior RGB preserved and boundary-only green despill. Existing fixed whole-frame registration unchanged.
groomMatting: Technical alpha and boundary-only green-screen decontamination; preserve dense interior RGB and all original video motions. One fixed uniform whole-frame registration per supplied clip.
